name: Ankle mobility
instructions: With the heel grounded, gently move the knee forward over the foot. Use a pain-free range.

name: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Select enough assistance for a controlled movement. Pull upward without swinging and lower smoothly.

name: Back extension
instructions: Hinge through a comfortable range and return until your trunk is aligned. Avoid overextending your back.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold a light band in front and pull hands apart through a comfortable range. Keep your trunk still.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Use a rack and suitable safeties. Brace your trunk, lower under control, and stand without rounding your back.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Use a spotter or safeties. Keep feet stable, lower the bar toward your chest with control, then press up.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Keep your trunk steady and elbows close. Curl the bar up and lower smoothly.

name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Place the bar close to your legs, brace your trunk and stand by extending hips and knees. Lower with control.

name: Barbell overhead press
instructions: Brace your trunk and press the bar overhead. Keep your back steady and lower toward your shoulders.

name: Battle ropes
instructions: Stand balanced with knees soft. Create controlled rope waves without locking your shoulders.

name: Bent-over barbell row
instructions: Hinge at your hips with a steady back. Pull the bar toward your trunk, then lower without swinging.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Alternate bringing a shoulder toward the opposite knee. Move slowly and keep your neck relaxed.

name: Bird dog
instructions: From hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping hips level. Return and alternate.

name: Box step-over
instructions: Step onto a stable box and down the other side. Use a height you can control and keep the whole foot supported.

name: Burpee
instructions: Move from standing to a supported plank and return. Step instead of jumping to reduce impact.

name: Cable chest fly
instructions: Stand balanced between the cables. Bring handles together with a slight elbow bend, then return slowly.

name: Calf stretch
instructions: Place hands against a wall and extend one leg behind. Keep that heel grounded and hold comfortably.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: From hands and knees, gently round and extend your back. Move slowly within a comfortable range.

name: Chest stretch
instructions: Rest a forearm against a stable doorway and gently turn away. Stop within a comfortable shoulder range.

name: Chest-supported row
instructions: Keep your chest supported on the bench. Pull weights toward your sides and lower with control.

name: Child's pose
instructions: Kneel and sit back toward your heels while reaching forward. Use support and a comfortable range.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Use a palms-toward-you grip on a secure bar. Pull up smoothly and lower without dropping.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent. Open the top knee while keeping hips steady, then return.

name: Cobra pose
instructions: Lie face down and lift your chest gently with hands supporting. Keep the lower back comfortable.

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across your chest and support it gently with the other arm. Keep shoulders relaxed.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie with knees bent. Lift your shoulders slightly using your trunk and lower without pulling on your neck.

name: Cycling
instructions: Use a suitable route and bike setup. Record timed intervals or loops with the lap control.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back and extend opposite arm and leg slowly. Keep your lower back comfortably supported.

name: Downward-facing dog
instructions: From hands and knees, lift hips upward with knees soft. Keep a comfortable reach through hands and feet.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a stable bench. Lower the dumbbells beside your chest and press them up with wrists supported.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Keep elbows close to your sides. Curl the weights without swinging your trunk, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Keep a slight elbow bend. Open arms only through a comfortable range, then bring the weights together.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Start weights near shoulder height. Press overhead through a comfortable range without arching your back.

name: Dumbbell shrug
instructions: Raise shoulders toward your ears, pause, then lower. Keep arms relaxed and avoid rolling your shoulders.

name: Elliptical trainer
instructions: Stand balanced on the pedals and move smoothly. Adjust resistance to a sustainable level.

name: Face pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward your face with elbows comfortably raised. Keep the load light enough to avoid leaning back.

name: Farmer carry
instructions: Carry manageable weights at your sides. Walk tall with a steady trunk and clear space ahead.

name: Flutter kick
instructions: Lie on your back and make small alternating leg movements. Keep the lower back supported.

name: Forward lunge
instructions: Step forward into a comfortable lunge, then push through the front foot to return. Alternate sides if desired.

name: Front raise
instructions: Raise weights in front with a small elbow bend. Keep your trunk steady and use a controlled range.

name: Front squat
instructions: Support the bar across the front of your shoulders. Keep elbows lifted and lower within a comfortable range.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Push through your heels, lift your hips, then lower slowly.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold the weight close to your chest. Sit down between your hips, keep heels grounded, and stand.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Keep palms facing each other. Curl the weights while holding elbows steady, then lower slowly.

name: Hamstring stretch
instructions: Extend one leg and hinge gently from the hip. Hold a comfortable stretch without bouncing.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a secure bar. Bring knees upward without swinging, then lower slowly.

name: Heel tap
instructions: Lie with knees bent and reach gently toward alternate heels. Keep your neck comfortable.

name: High knees
instructions: March or run on the spot, lifting knees comfortably. Keep posture tall and land softly.

name: Hip abduction machine
instructions: Adjust the seat, then open your legs against manageable resistance. Return with control.

name: Hip adduction machine
instructions: Adjust the pads comfortably. Bring your legs together smoothly and return without bouncing.

name: Hip flexor stretch
instructions: Use a half-kneeling stance. Gently move your hips forward while keeping your trunk upright.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Support your upper back on a stable bench. Lift hips until your trunk is level without arching your lower back.

name: Incline bench press
instructions: Set a moderate incline. Keep shoulders supported, lower the bar with control and press without bouncing.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised surface. Keep your body aligned and lower your chest toward it.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Use small controlled jumps and clear space. Keep knees soft and select a sustainable rhythm.

name: Jumping jack
instructions: Step or jump feet apart while raising arms, then return. Choose the low-impact step version if preferred.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Use a hip hinge to drive the weight forward. Keep your back steady and learn the technique before increasing load.

name: Knee push-up
instructions: Support yourself on hands and knees. Keep hips aligned with your trunk as you lower and press.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Keep your trunk steady. Pull the bar toward your upper chest, then let it return with control.

name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Step to one side, bend that knee and move your hips back. Keep the other leg comfortably extended.

name: Lateral raise
instructions: With slightly bent elbows, raise weights to the sides through a comfortable range. Lower without swinging.

name: Leg curl
instructions: Adjust the pads and pivot to fit. Curl the legs through a comfortable range, then return slowly.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Align the machine pivot with your knees. Extend the legs smoothly and lower without swinging.

name: Leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat for a comfortable depth. Push the platform away without locking knees, then return with control.

name: Lying leg raise
instructions: Keep your lower back supported. Raise and lower legs within a range you can control.

name: Machine chest press
instructions: Adjust handles near chest height. Keep your back supported and press through a comfortable range.

name: Machine seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest support. Pull handles toward your trunk and return without shrugging.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: From a stable high plank, bring one knee forward, then alternate. Choose a pace you can control.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Use a stable support for your free hand. Pull the dumbbell toward your hip while keeping your trunk steady.

name: Overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold a manageable weight overhead. Bend and extend elbows while keeping the trunk steady.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Stand side-on to the resistance. Press hands forward while resisting trunk rotation.

name: Pec deck
instructions: Adjust the seat and arm pads comfortably. Bring the pads together slowly and return within a comfortable range.

name: Plank
instructions: Support your body on forearms and toes. Keep a steady line through your trunk and breathe normally.

name: Preacher curl
instructions: Support upper arms on the pad. Curl through a comfortable range and avoid forcefully locking elbows.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Grip a secure bar, brace your trunk and pull yourself upward without swinging. Lower with control.

name: Push-up
instructions: Keep your trunk steady and hands comfortably apart. Lower your chest, then push up. Use a raised surface if needed.

name: Rear-foot elevated split squat
instructions: Rest one foot on a low stable support. Lower the front leg under control and keep the front heel grounded.

name: Resistance band row
instructions: Secure the band safely. Pull toward your trunk while keeping shoulders relaxed, then return slowly.

name: Reverse fly
instructions: Hinge or use chest support. Open your arms to the sides with a small elbow bend, then lower slowly.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step backward, lower both knees with control, then return to standing. Keep the front knee aligned with the foot.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: With a small knee bend, move your hips back and keep the weight near your legs. Stop before your back rounds.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Drive with the legs, lean slightly and pull the handle. Reverse that sequence on the recovery.

name: Running
instructions: Run at a sustainable pace. Tap Lap at each interval or loop; use the timer to record the whole activity.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit with a steady trunk and rotate gently from side to side. Use a light load or no load.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall with a stable trunk. Pull handles toward your body without leaning back, then extend arms slowly.

name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Keep the balls of your feet on the platform. Raise your heels, pause, then lower comfortably.

name: Side plank
instructions: Support yourself on one forearm and the side of your foot or knee. Lift hips and hold comfortably.

name: Single-leg deadlift
instructions: Balance on one leg, hinge at the hip and extend the other leg behind. Use a support if balance is difficult.

name: Sit-up
instructions: Use a comfortable range and controlled pace. Avoid pulling on your neck or using momentum.

name: Sled push
instructions: Keep your trunk stable and take controlled steps. Choose a load that allows steady movement.

name: Split squat
instructions: Use a staggered stance. Bend both knees while keeping balance, then return. Record reps for each side consistently.

name: Squat
instructions: Stand with feet comfortably apart. Bend hips and knees, keep heels grounded, then stand with control.

name: Stair climber
instructions: Step at a controlled pace and use rails for balance if needed. Avoid leaning heavily on the rails.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Hold a support if needed. Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower with control.

name: Standing quadriceps stretch
instructions: Use a support for balance. Bend one knee and hold the ankle gently without pulling into pain.

name: Stationary cycling
instructions: Adjust the seat and resistance comfortably. Use the timer for each interval.

name: Step-up
instructions: Place the whole foot on a stable step. Drive through that leg to stand up, then step down under control.

name: Swimming
instructions: Choose a comfortable stroke. Record laps when safe to interact with your device between lengths.

name: Thoracic rotation
instructions: From a side-lying or supported position, rotate your upper trunk gently while keeping hips steady.

name: Triceps dip
instructions: Use secure bars or assistance. Lower only through a comfortable shoulder range, then press up.

name: Triceps kickback
instructions: Hinge forward with a steady trunk. Keep the upper arm still while extending the elbow behind you.

name: Triceps pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows near your sides. Extend arms down without moving your trunk, then return slowly.

name: Walking
instructions: Walk at a comfortable pace. Record a lap at each loop or interval if helpful.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Take controlled lunge steps forward. Allow space ahead and count each step as one rep.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Lean your back against a wall and bend knees to a comfortable depth. Hold while breathing normally.

name: Wrist curl
instructions: Support your forearm with the wrist free. Curl the wrist through a small comfortable range and lower slowly.
